fields.name: Ridgeline 2 Tent
fields.description: Freestanding two-person three-season backpacking tent. 3.4 lb packed weight, double-wall, two doors and two vestibules.

fields.name: Basecamp 4 Tent
fields.description: Roomy four-person family camping tent with a full-coverage rainfly and a large front porch. 11 lb.

fields.name: Cascade 20F Down Sleeping Bag
fields.description: Mummy bag with 800-fill water-resistant down. Comfort rating 25F, limit rating 20F. 2 lb 4 oz. Regular and long sizes.

fields.name: Meadow 30F Synthetic Sleeping Bag
fields.description: Budget-friendly rectangular synthetic bag for summer camping. Comfort rating 40F, limit rating 30F. 3 lb 8 oz.

fields.name: Summit Insulated Sleeping Pad
fields.description: Air pad with R-value 4.2 for cold-weather camping. 1 lb 2 oz, packs to the size of a water bottle.

fields.name: Trailhead 55L Backpack
fields.description: 55-litre internal-frame backpack with adjustable torso length, rain cover included. Suits 3 to 5 day trips.

fields.name: Pocket Rocket Stove
fields.description: Ultralight canister stove that boils a litre of water in about 3.5 minutes. 3 oz. Fuel canister sold separately.

fields.name: Isobutane Fuel Canister 230g
fields.description: Isobutane-propane blend canister, fits most screw-on backpacking stoves. Ground shipping only.

fields.name: Trail Squeeze Water Filter
fields.description: Hollow-fibre filter removing bacteria and protozoa, filters 1 litre per minute. Rated for 100,000 litres. 3 oz.

fields.name: Beacon 350 Headlamp
fields.description: Rechargeable 350-lumen headlamp with a red night-vision mode and a 40-hour low setting. Waterproof to IPX6.
